proof_body:
by
  intro a z
  have e : ∀ n, (FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars ℂ a n) (fun _ => z) = a n * z ^ n := fun n => by
    simpa using FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars_apply_eq (E := ℂ) a z n
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' : z ∈ Metric.eball (0 : ℂ) (FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars ℂ a).radius := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_eball, edist_zero_right, enorm_eq_nnnorm] using h
    have := (FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars ℂ a).summable_norm_apply h'
    simpa [e] using this
  · intro h hs
    have := (FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars ℂ a).not_summable_norm_of_radius_lt_nnnorm h
    apply this
    have := hs.norm
    simpa [e] using this
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℂ) (z : ℂ), (((‖z‖₊ : NNReal) : ENNReal) < (FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars ℂ a).radius → Summable (fun n => ‖a n * z ^ n‖)) ∧ ((FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars ℂ a).radius < ((‖z‖₊ : NNReal) : ENNReal) → ¬ Summable (fun n => a n * z ^ n))
